Instead, the diff adds a separate bossWarning({status, spawner}) in src/hud.js, which render calls next to hudModel(state). hudModel is unchanged and has no boss flag. The announcement still works and is tested, so the outcome is met, but it does not take the shape the brief described. Folding the flag into hudModel would keep all HUD state in one model.

A test pinning the boss/waveSize-override interaction would make that intent explicit.
